name: Hotel National
insider_take: Where Soviet grandeur meets modern luxury in the shadow of the Kremlin walls
whats_special: This historic 1903 Art Nouveau masterpiece sits directly across from Red Square and the Kremlin, making it the closest luxury hotel to Moscow's iconic landmarks. Originally built for the wealthy merchant class, it survived the Soviet era and was meticulously restored to blend imperial Russian elegance with contemporary sophistication.
pro_tip: Book a Red Square view room on an upper floor - you'll have front-row seats to the nightly illumination of St. Basil's Cathedral and can watch the changing of the guard ceremony from your window.
dont_miss: The hotel's rooftop terrace offers unparalleled 360-degree views of Moscow's skyline, while the ground floor houses one of the city's most exclusive shopping galleries. Take the 2-minute walk to explore the cobblestones of Red Square at sunrise when it's virtually empty of tourists.
pros: Prime location facing Red Square and the Kremlin
Historic luxury property with elegant Art Nouveau architecture
Multiple acclaimed dining venues including rooftop restaurant
cons: Historic building may have smaller room sizes
